title: Meeting Rooms II
summary: Find the minimum number of rooms needed to run every meeting at its listed time.
statement: Find the minimum number of rooms needed to run every meeting at its listed time. A room can be reused immediately when a meeting ends.

examples.explanation: The shorter meetings share a room while the first uses another.
One room can host the meetings back to back.

hints: Conceptual: Rooms are needed simultaneously only while meetings are active.
Directional: Sweep starts and ends in chronological order.
Implementation: When times tie, release rooms before adding the meetings that start at that time. Track the peak active count.
complexityAnalysis: O(n log n) time and O(n) extra space for sorted events.
